postmortems.lesson: Backtest a STABLE stop/re-entry guard that suppresses strategy re-entries after a stop when alt_gate is risk-off or exit_50w is true, or requires a reclaim of the stop/exit level for reclaim_weeks, and measure whether it reduces post-re-entry min_vs_exit drawdowns without materially reducing winning

Backtest a re-entry confirmation gate after exit_50w/risk-off exits: require price above the 50-week MA for reclaim_weeks and alt_gate unblocked before re-entering, and test whether this reduces whipsaw losses in historical cases where post-reentry min_vs_exit is positive.

Backtest a re-entry confirmation gate after exit_50w/risk-off exits: require price above the 50-week MA for reclaim_weeks and alt_gate unblocked before re-entering, and test whether this reduces whipsaw losses in historical cases where post-reentry min_vs_exit is positive.

postmortems.lesson: In risk-off / below-50w regimes, stop-loss re-entries should require a volatility-scaled reclaim buffer above the stop exit, not just a fixed 5% stop, to avoid whipsaw re-entry at higher prices.
